mapper.sql: rp.id, rp.rate_plan_code AS ratePlanCode, rp.name, category.code AS categoryCode, category.name AS categoryName, rp.monthly_fee AS monthlyFee, rp.sales_status AS salesStatus, rp.updated_at AS updatedAt

where.if: AND ( LOWER(rp.rate_plan_code) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(TRIM(#{condition.keyword})), '%') OR LOWER(rp.name) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(TRIM(#{condition.keyword})), '%') )

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM rate_plans rp JOIN rate_plan_categories category ON category.id = rp.category_id
ORDER BY
rp.rate_plan_code rp.name rp.monthly_fee rp.updated_at
ASC DESC , rp.id ASC LIMIT #{condition.size} OFFSET #{condition.offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rate_plans rp JOIN rate_plan_categories category ON category.id = rp.category_id
